title: podolobium procumbens
intro: Podolobium procumbens, commonly known as Golden Pea or Native Pea, is a flowering plant native to eastern Australia. Research suggests that this plant has potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. These bioactive constituents may help to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
